json.description: Any JSON value, carried verbatim. Strings inside it are never references to other parts of the document.

object_id.description: The `id` of an object in one of the document's layers.

point.description: A point in the space the field's description names, in points (1/72 inch); x grows right, y grows down.

center.description: The document point at the centre of the window.

name.description: The view's name (empty for the view the document was saved with).

rotation.description: Rotation of the canvas in degrees. Absent: 0.

description: How VectorCraft's windows and dialogs were when the document was saved. None of it changes the artwork.

export_settings.description: The parameters File > Export for Screens last ran with, by parameter name. Folder names in it are a record of where exports went, never something a reader follows.

last_view.description: The view the document was saved with; it reopens there. Null: fitted to the window.

layers_open.description: The rows open in the Layers panel. Null: only the top-level layers.

paste_remembers_layers.description: Pasted objects go back into the layers they were copied from.

print_setup.description: The print settings saved with the document (null: never set up).

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema: 1.

views.description: Saved views (View > New View), in menu order.

title: x.vectorcraft.session - VectorCraft's view and panel state
